summary: SiteDocument is a C# object representing documents associated with a specific site, with properties for ID and SiteID. It is likely used for mapping and managing site-specific documents within the application.
purpose: To encapsulate and manage the relationship between a document and its associated site, enabling retrieval, storage, and manipulation of site documents.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Primary identifier for the site document.

system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are instantiated and stored with reference to a SiteID.
No explicit workflows or system events described for this class.
content_gaps: No information about methods, usage context, or integration with the wider system.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page for staff administrators, providing a user interface for managing employment applications, filtering by site and discipline, and displaying warnings/errors. It features data binding, validation, and postback-driven workflows for viewing submissions.
purpose: To allow staff admins to view, filter, and interact with submitted employment applications, with controls for managing display, handling errors/warnings, and filtering data views.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: User selects site, discipline, and date range.
Optional: User toggles 'Show Withdrawn' checkbox.
User clicks 'Refresh View' (cmdRefreshView).
GridView (gvwApplications) displays results.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are indicated by status and 'WithdrawnDate' field.
Only valid date ranges are accepted (custom validator checks start-end dates).
validations: CustomValidator checkStartEnd ensures start date is not after end date.
conditions: If no applications are found, message 'No_Data' is displayed.
system_behavior: Page loads with default search range.
Data binding and filtering on dropdown change.
Grid displays employment applications with filtering and paging.
content_gaps: No details on workflows beyond application filtering.
No exception handling or detailed business rules outside UI controls.

summary: ServiceCode is an object representing a coded service option, with attributes for ID, category, code, names (including alternative language fields), sort order, and notes. ServiceCodes can be listed, filtered by CourseID or TimetableID, and localized.
purpose: To define and manage service codes used in the application, support multiple languages, categorize services, and provide options for course or timetable data entry.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeListAll with session.
Iterate SQL results and populate ServiceCode objects.
Localize entries if session is in alt language mode.

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Course
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with CourseID.
Populate ServiceCode list for ASM options.

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Timetable
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with TimetableID.
Populate ServiceCode list for timetable options.

business_rules: If alt language mode is active, use NameAlt for display.
system_behavior: ServiceCode objects are created and localized based on session language mode.
ServiceCode lists are retrieved from stored procedures and returned for UI display.
dependencies: Database stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID
content_gaps: No info about input validation or error handling.

summary: SiteProfileHistory is a detailed audit log object showing changes to site profiles, including action dates, user information, agencies, phone, and alternative language fields. The class supports formatted output for audit, search, and display.
purpose: To track changes made to site profiles for auditing, accountability, and review purposes.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the audit entry.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Whether the user is a system admin.

workflows.name: Audit Site Profile Changes
steps: User modifies site profile (fields, sections).
Audit entry is created with timestamp, user, agency, fields changed.
Audit entry is returned and displayed in audit logs/UI.

business_rules: If the user is not sysadmin and user IDs differ, display support team context.
Format name and agency for display.
calculations: Formatted user and date fields provided for display.
conditions: Audit entries are created only when site profile changes occur.
system_behavior: Audit entries are generated and displayed.
Audit entries are formatted depending on session language mode and phone formatting.
content_gaps: No details on UI integration or exception handling.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is a serializable object for managing email-related documents, including file name, file path, checkbox status, and ID. Includes workflow for searching and deleting files/folders associated with email popups.
purpose: To enable searching, listing, and deletion of email popup documents and associated files within the application.

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Call Search with DataInfo string.
Parse DataInfo by '|', split by '>' for file details.
Create EmailPopupDocument objects for each file.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Call Delete with DataInfo and ID.
Delete file at FilePath, then delete folder.
Remove entry from DataInfo string.

business_rules: DataInfo string must be non-empty to operate.
If file and folder exist, delete; otherwise, ignore errors.
conditions: Delete only occurs if DataInfo is non-empty and ID matches index.
system_behavior: EmailPopupDocument objects are created from parsed file strings.
Deletion workflow removes files/folders safely, ignores errors.
exceptions: Deletion errors are silently caught and ignored.
content_gaps: No info on UI triggers or user interactions.
